title: Multi-action screens — revised review
description: Screens with three or more simultaneous action controls. Navigation menus, card-management rows, payment-method lists and other repeated selectors are excluded.

items.note: Add, Send and Request are peer quick actions above a separate Complete verification action, like the supplied example.
The same three quick actions remain visible for a verified user, with a different home-card state.
Upload proof of address, Upload identity documents and Contact support are separate remediation controls.
Sign up, Log in and Recover wallet are visible together.
Continue anyway, Notify me and Change country are distinct next steps.
Send, Request and Join Peanut are separate actions on one page.
Retry, Talk to support and Go back to home are simultaneous recovery actions.
Split bill or Home, See receipt and Invite friends appear as separate actions, depending on account state.
Go home appears beside two support controls that duplicate an intent.
